title: Integrative Approaches in Protein Structure/Function Analysis, Design, and Engineering.
authors: Sun, Zhoutong; Yuan, Bo; Shi, Jinghao; Wang, Yikai
one_liner_zh: 该综述概述了蛋白质设计策略（定向进化、理性/半理性设计）及AI与多尺度建模在酶设计中的应用，虽涉及蛋白质结构计算，但以综述为主、方法创新有限。
abstract: Over the past decade, protein design has drawn considerable attention and emerged as a promising tool for sustainable and efficient biocatalytic processes, driven by breakthroughs in DNA sequencing, gene synthesis, bioinformatics, and artificial intelligence. Enabled by strategies such as directed evolution, structure/function analysis, and (semi-)rational design, engineered enzymes can now accommodate nonnatural substrates, catalyze novel reactions, and operate under harsh conditions including elevated temperatures and organic solvents.This chapter provides a comprehensive overview of major strategies in protein design including directed evolution, rational design, and semi-rational design. Emphasis is placed on recent advances in high-throughput screening technologies, identification of functionally critical residues, and optimization of site-specific mutations. Furthermore, the integration of artificial intelligence and multiscale modeling to enzyme design is discussed, highlighting data-driven decision-making and deep learning-assisted prediction of enzymatic performance. Looking forward, biocatalysis is poised to further expand its applications in valorization of renewable resources, biofuels, and synthetic chemistry. Powered by ongoing advances in AI and computational protein design, the development of enzymes with unprecedented catalytic functions is anticipated to accelerate rapidly.
abstract_zh: 过去十年间，蛋白质设计引起了广泛关注，并凭借DNA测序、基因合成、生物信息学及人工智能领域的突破，成为可持续且高效生物催化过程中颇具前景的工具。借助定向进化、结构/功能分析及（半）理性设计等策略，工程化酶现已能够适应非天然底物、催化新型反应，并在高温及有机溶剂等严苛条件下运行。本章全面概述了蛋白质设计的主要策略，包括定向进化、理性设计和半理性设计，并重点探讨了高通量筛选技术、功能关键残基鉴定及位点特异性突变优化方面的最新进展。此外，还讨论了人工智能与多尺度建模在酶设计中的整合，强调了数据驱动决策及深度学习辅助的酶性能预测。展望未来，生物催化有望进一步拓展其在可再生资源增值、生物燃料及合成化学中的应用。得益于人工智能和计算蛋白质设计的持续进步，具有前所未有催化功能的酶开发预计将加速推进。
